source: SPEC-v8-undeniable.md §3 (Scribe): ambient world lines — one-line thoughts the figure has while walking, shown in a whisper bubble ~45s into each era's walk. Voice per src/data/v3-copy.json: terse, ledger-brained interior monologue. 17 eras × 4 = 68 lines, ≤60 chars each. Naming per SPEC §8.

lines.text: Cold is a debt the body pays daily.
Two fires counted. One more than yesterday.
The dark keeps no ledger. We do.
Every step out is a loan against the cave.
Seed now, harvest later. The oldest deal.
The field owes. The field always pays late.
A season kept is a season itemized.
We traded standing still for waiting rich.
Bronze remembers who paid for it.
Roads are receipts with mileage.
The law is stone until someone chips it.
Empire: interest compounded over people.
Knowledge decays at one copy per winter.
The road to town is longer than it was.
What isn't copied is already lost.
Rome lives on installment plans now.
A printed page argues cheaper than a priest.
The guild counts me; I count the guild.
Bell rung, debt entered. Both ring true.
Interest learned its alphabet here.
Wind is free labor. It invoices anyway.
Every map is a claim with coastline.
Cargo rots slower than credit. Barely.
The ocean keeps a parallel ledger.
Rights read better than they audit.
A crown fits any hand firm enough.
Terror has its own accounting staff.
Ideals burn hot. Fuel bills stay due.
Coal is sunlight, billed late.
The timetable forgives no one, least me.
Machines multiply what we already owed.
Smoke is the invoice. The sky never disputes it.
Everything is a line item now, boots included.
Mass production: want, standardized.
The ticker knows before the street does.
We measure progress in tonnage and dust.
Total war: the audit that eats the auditors.
My ration card is my whole estate.
Everyone I know is on a list somewhere.
Victory will be an inventory count.
Half-life taught me patience in years.
Deterrence: a balance nobody dares withdraw.
The fallout lands on the unpaid.
Peace is just deferred settlement.
Orbit is altitude plus paperwork.
One small step, amortized over decades.
The Moon has no customs office yet.
Up here, every gram costs coin.
Garbage in, prophecy out. Mind the input.
I think in flowsheets now. So does everyone.
A bug is a debt that compounds nightly.
The mainframe rents humility by the hour.
Carbon is the ledger we forged.
Sunlight finally arrived on time. And tax-free.
Every tonne cut is a receipt for later.
The curve bends or the bill stands.
Attention prices everything, including this walk.
I am content now. So is everyone I was.
The feed audits me faster than I audit it.
Free means someone else footed it.
Silence has a delivery date: eleven years.
The archive thins one polite deletion at a time.
Between stars, a word costs a year.
We carry ancestors in cold storage now.
The question was asked. No one answers first.
Tempo is the last scarce resource.
Nine thousand years, closing entry pending.
Whatever comes next inherits this column.
